### Historical audit

**Scope and goal.** H0123 is a teacher-only review trace, not a student implementation trace. The inferred underlying goal was recursive agent delegation with parent continuation and provider compatibility; the teacher’s immediate role was to assess a prior trajectory and its hint use. The original student request, hint delivery, student events and reference diff are not independently present here.

All citations below refer to **H0123**, original file `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_12/lanes/codex_parallel_12_lane0/codex_parallel_12_lane0_H/reviews/claude-code-by-agents-recursive-delegation/round_1/teacher/trajs.json`; offsets are half-open observation character ranges.

| Evidence | Audit finding |
|---|---|
| `main_agent:event:1–6`, respectively `[0,598)`, `[0,594)`, `[0,579)`, `[0,4876)`, `[0,13350)`, `[0,23561)` | The teacher independently requested and received three file reads. The observed handler executes a provider and returns on `done`; the observed request type includes `availableAgents`; the observed Anthropic adapter builds messages and parses text streaming. These are snapshots, not direct evidence of the later student changes described in the review. |
| `main_agent:event:9 [0,8770)` | The teacher **reports**, rather than directly shows, student rounds adding recursive delegation, tool types and streaming support. It diagnoses unconditional tool advertisement, missing request-level target authorization, context and message-coalescing problems, cycle behavior and incomplete stream checks. Its comparison to a reference diff is also a teacher claim in this record. |
| `main_agent:event:9 [0,8770)` | The teacher reports a passing narrow mock continuation reproduction, a typecheck blocked by missing `cli/version.ts`, and outstanding tests, cleanup and commit. Thus its assessment is **partial correctness**, not verified task success; the cause of any external evaluation failure remains unknown. The typecheck issue is a reported technical obstacle, not proof of an interrupted teacher run. |
| `main_agent:event:7–8`, `[0,8808)` and `[0,8713)` | The teacher wrote a review and corrective recommendation to `/tmp/review_output.md`; the tool confirmed file creation. No project-code edit or test execution by this teacher is visible. The empty `structuredPatch` accompanies creation of that review file and is not evidence of an empty student patch. |
| `main_agent:event:9 [0,8770)`; `top_level_metadata [0,12721)` | The teacher asserts partial use of an earlier hint and proposes capability gating, target validation, context preservation and stronger tests. Neither actual hint receipt nor subsequent receipt or adoption of this corrective recommendation is visible. The teacher session itself completed successfully; that status does not validate the implementation. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, a narrow mock success need not establish compatibility or authorization boundaries; distinguish detection, diagnosis, recommendation and execution. Task-specific hypotheses concern `availableAgents`, provider tool support and native message coalescing. Their effect on real requests and evaluation remains unverified in this teacher-only record. No scene is involved, so object count, materials, connections, pose, camera, lighting and rendering are not applicable.
